name: web_search
description: Look up a single fact from the corporate knowledge base. Returns the value associated with the query, or 'no results' if the key is not present. The KB only contains facts about a fixed set of fictional entities; do not use this for general web search.

query.description: A query string that must exactly match a KB key, e.g. 'population of Vega City', 'founding year of Atlas Foundation'.
